method: Each decision rests on the takedown variant takes takedown-variants-v1254d-g (candidates 1214cn, cp, cq) under the product controller with natural guard AI and the NPC stream on, both source roles: the source performs a native takedown on the upper-floor Dunwall guard (side and front approaches start crouched), the partner presents every census-1253 takedown scene the source played, both worlds must reach the same outcome (unconscious or dead) and the victim must end within 2 m in both worlds; the checkpoint is reloaded after every case. Reviewed observer videos are listed per item.

items.scope: Every passing takedown in both roles (back, side, front, drop and slide; chokes and lethals; 15 cases in 1254g alone) ends with the same outcome in both worlds and the victim within 0-0.03 m of the same place, the partner presenting the source side of the paired scene.
